title: Crispy Nostalgic Fish Tofu Sticks
description: A modern twist on a classic Chinese dish, combining the crunch of nostalgic fish sticks with the nutty taste of tempeh, all wrapped up in a light and crispy trout-based coating.
instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, mix together the flour and cornstarch.
2. In a separate dish, beat the egg.
3. Cut the trout fillets into small pieces.
4. Dip each piece of tempeh into the egg and then coat with the flour mixture.
5. Heat about 1/2-inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
6. When the oil is hot, add a few pieces of the coated tempeh to the skillet.
7. Fry until golden brown and crispy on both sides, about 3-4 minutes.
8. Remove the fried tempeh from the skillet and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
9. Repeat the frying process with the remaining tempeh pieces.
10. Serve the crispy tempeh sticks hot, garnished with your favorite dipping sauce.
